ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels. White pixels are concentrated on the distal margins of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lateral regions of both lobes feature large, high-contrast white patches. The left lobe white patch is more fragmented with black mottling, while the right lobe features a more contiguous white area with a distinct central dark spot. The central fluke body and leading edges are solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a visible angle of approximately 70 degrees at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits sharper, more defined sawtooth peaks compared to the left lobe. Deepest indentation observed on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly rounded distal tips; leading edge exhibits a standard convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed within the white patches on both lobes, particularly dense on the lower margin of the right white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe, suggesting physical wear or historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark 'eye' spot is located within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe distal region.
